title: Chamber Singers
description: An auditioned choral ensemble performing advanced choral repertoire from a diverse spectrum of composers and styles.
notes: Credit will be granted for only four of MUS 580F, MUS 580A, MUS 580B, MUS 580C, MUS 580D, MUS 580E, MUS 580G, MUS 580H.
Open to all students by audition. Previous choral experience and strong music skills required.
A combined undergraduate and graduate course.
